label: SIMULATED TRAFFIC — Playwright persona bots, not humans. Demonstration of the pipeline; outcomes follow the persona model, not evidence about real users.

notes: Fixed horizon of 400 identities per site (~200/arm, random 50/50). Cap is Playwright runtime for eight sequential sites, not the 50k/month Flagsmith API budget (local eval + batched events keep HTTP to a few hundred calls).
Node SDK local evaluation: environment document ~1–2 times per site, not per visitor.
Playwright bots do not call the JS SDK. Events flush in batches (~1–2 POSTs/site).
Admin: ensure feature/metric/experiment/start (~20) + results poll/refresh (~6) + complete/GET (~2) per site.
20-identity rollout check uses local evaluation (no extra Flags API).

aggregate.explanation: Headline is the unweighted median of per-site relative lifts (treatment vs control conversion rate). Sites are not a sample of the web; each row is its own experiment with an assumed persona mix. Pooled lift (visitors summed across sites) is shown as a sensitivity check — it weights larger n more, and it is not the headline because sites have different flows and are not exchangeable.
aggregate.pooledCopy: Pooled sensitivity (summed n, not the headline): 27.0% (control 895/1587 vs treatment 1155/1613).
aggregate.multipleTestingNote: 8 separate tests were run at 95% with no multiple-testing correction.
